name: Passort
description: Performance Assort for NTS-3. The effect locks from where you first touch the pad, then finger motion drives that effect. Top-left = HPF (right cutoff, down resonance). Top-right = LPF (left cutoff, down resonance). Center = tape stop. Bottom-left = dotted-8th delay (up depth, right feedback HPF). Bottom-right = beat-sync step roll (up speed, left shorter buffer). Depth = overall wet. Untouched = bypass.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Overall dry/wet while an effect region is engaged

params.name: FDBK
params.detail: Delay feedback amount for the dotted-8th delay region
